q:
Cloze Test (1/5): Select the most appropriate option for Blank No. 1.

'The environment is (1)______ due to human activities. Climate change has led to (2)______ weather patterns. It is high time we (3)______ corrective measures. (4)______ use of plastics must be discouraged. Our future (5)______ on our actions today.'
e: Blank 1: 'Deteriorating' (बिगड़ना) पर्यावरण के खराब होने के लिए सबसे सटीक शब्द है।

q:
Cloze Test (2/5): Select the most appropriate option for Blank No. 2.

'The environment is (1)______ due to human activities. Climate change has led to (2)______ weather patterns. It is high time we (3)______ corrective measures. (4)______ use of plastics must be discouraged. Our future (5)______ on our actions today.'
e: Blank 2: 'Erratic' (अनिश्चित) मौसम के बदलते मिजाज के लिए उपयोग होता है।

q:
Cloze Test (3/5): Select the most appropriate option for Blank No. 3.

'The environment is (1)______ due to human activities. Climate change has led to (2)______ weather patterns. It is high time we (3)______ corrective measures. (4)______ use of plastics must be discouraged. Our future (5)______ on our actions today.'
e: Grammar: 'It is high time' के बाद हमेशा Simple Past (V2 - took) का प्रयोग होता है।

q:
Cloze Test (4/5): Select the most appropriate option for Blank No. 4.

'The environment is (1)______ due to human activities. Climate change has led to (2)______ weather patterns. It is high time we (3)______ corrective measures. (4)______ use of plastics must be discouraged. Our future (5)______ on our actions today.'
e: Blank 4: 'Indiscriminate' (बिना सोचे-समझे/अंधाधुंध) प्लास्टिक के इस्तेमाल के लिए सही शब्द है।

q:
Cloze Test (5/5): Select the most appropriate option for Blank No. 5.

'The environment is (1)______ due to human activities. Climate change has led to (2)______ weather patterns. It is high time we (3)______ corrective measures. (4)______ use of plastics must be discouraged. Our future (5)______ on our actions today.'
e: Blank 5: 'Hinges on' (पर निर्भर होना) एक Phrasal Verb है जिसका अर्थ 'Depends on' है।

q: Error Spotting: Not only the (A) / doctors but (B) / also the nurse (C) / were vigilant (D).
e: Rule: 'Not only... but also' में verb पास वाले subject (nurse - Singular) के अनुसार 'was' होनी चाहिए।

q: Error Spotting: He had (A) / scarcely finished (B) / his meal (C) / than the phone rang (D).
e: Rule: 'Scarcely' के साथ 'when' का प्रयोग होता है, 'than' का नहीं।

q: Error Spotting: I would (A) / rather die (B) / than (C) / to beg (D).
e: Rule: 'Would rather... than' के बाद bare infinitive (बिना 'to' के V1) आता है। सही: 'than beg'।

q: Error Spotting: It is (A) / a most (B) / unique (C) / opportunity (D).
e: Unique के साथ 'most' नहीं लगता। सही: 'a unique opportunity'।

q: Error Spotting: I can (A) / rely on (B) / him for (C) / his advices (D).
e: 'Advice' uncountable है, इसका 'advices' नहीं होता। सही: 'his advice'।

o: To leave no means of retreat
e: वापस लौटने के सभी रास्ते बंद कर देने को 'Burn one's boats' कहते हैं।

q: One-word Substitution: A person who is indifferent to pleasure or pain.
e: Stoic (वैरागी) वह है जिसे सुख-दुख से कोई फर्क न पड़े।

q: Direct/Indirect: He said, 'I will do it now.'
o: He said that he would do it then
He said he will do then
e: 'Will' बदलकर 'would' और 'now' बदलकर 'then' हो जाता है।
